name: Chicken Baja Chipotle Hot Pockets
desc: High-protein air fryer pockets of chicken, bacon and Swiss with a blended chipotle guajillo cottage cheese sauce.

source.title: Chicken Baja Chipotle Hot Pockets
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp kosher salt and 1/2 tsp garlic powder, for the chicken
11 large low-carb tortillas, such as Mission Carb Balance
1 large egg, beaten with 1 tbsp water (egg wash)
57 g (about 1/4 cup) adobo sauce from a can of chipotles
ingredients.item: adobo sauce from a can of chipotles

ingredients.raw: 1/2 tsp kosher salt, or to taste
1/2 tsp garlic powder, or to taste

steps: Season the chicken with the salt and garlic powder and cook it your preferred way (grill, air fryer, or a 425°F oven for 20-25 min) until it reaches 165°F in the thickest part. Rest 5 min, then chop.
Cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat 8-10 min until crisp. Drain on paper towels and chop.
Cover the guajillo with hot water and soak 10 min. Remove the stem and seeds.
Blend the guajillo, adobo sauce, cottage cheese, cream cheese, mayo, vinegar, salt and garlic powder until smooth. Taste and adjust.
Divide the chicken into 11 even portions. On each tortilla spread 1 tbsp sauce, then add a portion of chicken, some bacon, 1 slice of Swiss and a pinch of cheddar.
Fold each tortilla burrito style, tucking in the sides, and set seam side down. Brush the tops with egg wash.
Air fry at 400°F for 7-8 min, in batches, until golden and crisp.
tips: 311 cal and 36g protein each. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 1 month in the freezer.
The creator's ingredient total lists 400 g cottage cheese but places only 200 g in the sauce; the other 200 g has no stated use, so it is left out here.
The sauce makes more than the 11 tbsp the pockets need; serve the rest for dipping.
